review_basis: Actual acquired previews, file-specific Commons imageinfo/extmetadata for each accepted candidate, the supplied handoff notes, and the cross-leaf identity audit. Visual selection is distinct from source identity and rights checking.

relationship_reviews.finding: Same photographer (Acabashi); three different places in Lincolnshire and Essex. Different scenes; no capture relationship seen. Photographer reuse alone is not an exclusion.

Same photographer (julesvernex2); an aircraft at Brooklands, a child in Lisbon and an olive tree at Ponte de Sor. Different scenes; no capture relationship seen. The handoff withheld the '-2' sibling of PI-26.
Both Seattle; an alley in Pioneer Square and a carousel in Westlake Park by different uploaders. Different scenes.
The handoff excluded the documented cropped derivative 'Puddle Hopping-cropped.jpg'; only the original is a candidate.
The handoff withheld 'Trekvlietplein (06)' from the same numbered series; only '(01)' is a candidate.
